keySource: Reference PDF answer key, memory-only scoring; no option key indices emitted
metric: Dark RGB max <160; production reddish predicate; correct-minus-other-four mean and descriptive z. Exploratory flag |z|>=2, or nonzero difference with zero other-choice variance.
geometryMethod: Same question-level marker width; common first-line height from A-D median capped at .018 page height; own OCR x/y anchor retained. No key is used in geometry or baseline.
normalizationMethod: Aligned dark density minus leave-one-question-out median for same option letter/position; minimum eight finite peer questions per position. Baseline is pooled across page styles and does not certify glyph recognition.
limits: OCR anchors can be wrong; fixed first-line windows are geometry normalization, not verified glyph boxes.
Five choices do not yield a calibrated statistical leakage detector; no multiple-testing control.
Letter/position baselines mix fonts, pages and possible marked options; robust median does not guarantee clean controls.
Body-loss normalization retains dependence on differing option content; body erasure is a remaining signal and content-loss risk.
Masked metric reconstructs the production strip at 144 DPI; protected image scan reports actual stored student image red ratio separately.
Missing question/option geometry remains unknown and cannot support a no-leakage conclusion.
claim: Zero red is not proof of no leakage; geometry/baseline normalization is descriptive and no leak-free claim is made.
